data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 claims a relation of COMPATIBLE WITH between continuous pro-rata and discrete bundle-only models, but its own refutation test exposes this as analytically incoherent: if a non-multiple quantity (10 pencils) forces the models apart, the relation is not compatibility but mere intersection at a degenerate point. The artifact fails to name the actual substantive relation — which is *contradiction partially masked by coincidental agreement* — and instead labels a special-case coincidence as a structural relation. The problem requires a substantive connection naming its kind, but what is described is not a genuine compatibilty relation: it is the absence of one everywhere except where arithmetic accident suppresses it.
